Programming Projects Catalogue

A collection of custom web games and a full OS simulator I built from scratch (literally). Everything here was originally coded in Scratch, then compiled to JavaScript using TurboWarp Packager to ensure high-performance gameplay. Because these are hosted as single index.html files on GitHub Pages, you can download that file and run every project offline with zero dependencies! Dates in brackets indicate their original Scratch release. If you are still not satisfied, check out my Scratch account for a bunch of other fun projects too!


1. The Haunted House (May 2022) (mobile-friendly)



A first-person arcade-style game of stealth where you're trapped inside a mansion infested with scary monsters! Navigate the haunted house and collect as much candy as you can, while trying to survive as long as possible for the highest score possible!

🏆 Most popular - Scratch community's favourite with 946 views, 35 ❤️,26 ⭐, 7 Remixes, and 47 Comments.

Experience The Haunted House now!

2. Red Ball (Jun 2022) (mobile-friendly)



A classic 2D platformer where you collect collectibles like stars and keys, and stomp on enemies' heads! Utilize moving platforms and jump-through platforms; dodge spikes and pits; activate checkpoints and doors; all to conquer the final goal!

🥈 Second most popular - 583 views, 14 ❤️, 14 ⭐

3. Fight-and-3D-self! (A pun on "Free the self") (Sep 2022)



A custom 3D raycasting maze-runner with real-time monster combat, potion management, but primarily involves a rush to the exit, especially in the later stages! Navigate tight corridors, defeat enemies with a variety of weapons, and most of all, remember to keep your health topped up throughout the mazes!

🥉 Third most popular - 191 views, 8❤️, 4⭐

Free yourself in Fight-and-3D-self now!

4. iush (Aug 2026)



An OS simulator built inside Scratch! Standing for Interactive User Shell, iush is a fully functional virtual command-line environment, featuring custom string parsing, chainable terminal commands, and built-in apps: Notepad, Paint, Regedit, and Domemory - a spaced repetition tool powered by a modified pre-trained SuperMemo-5 algorithm to retain lots of information quickly!

Check out the GitHub repository for full system documentation, command lists, and some fun things you can do inside iush.

Initialize iush now!
